evals.name: monorepo-auto-push-origin
evals.expected_output: pnpm monorepo (root + packages/a, packages/b, all at 1.2.3; latest tag v1.2.3; remotes origin and upstream; untracked notes.txt): every package.json goes to 1.3.0 with the lockfile refreshed, [Unreleased] becomes [v1.3.0] - <today> under a new empty [Unreleased], commit chore(release): v1.3.0, annotated tag v1.3.0, then `git push origin HEAD v1.3.0` without asking.
expectations: Root and every workspace package.json have version 1.3.0
CHANGELOG.md contains `## [v1.3.0] - <today>` with a new empty `## [Unreleased]` above it
The release commit excludes the untracked notes.txt (no `git add -A`)
Annotated tag v1.3.0 is created
Pushes to origin, not upstream, without asking the user
Pushes only the current branch and v1.3.0, without `--all` or `--tags`

evals.name: maven-patch-asks-remote
evals.expected_output: Maven multi-module project (parent pom + 2 child modules at 0.4.1-SNAPSHOT; latest tag 0.4.0; only remote is named github, no origin): the patch argument releases 0.4.1, so every module goes to 0.4.1 with -SNAPSHOT dropped; the tag keeps the unprefixed style as 0.4.1; after commit and tag, asks which remote to push to and holds the push until answered.
expectations: Parent pom and both child modules have version 0.4.1, with no -SNAPSHOT left
Tag is named 0.4.1, following the existing unprefixed style
Release commit and tag exist locally
Asks which remote to push to, and runs no `git push` before the answer

evals.name: no-remote-no-tag-first-release
evals.expected_output: Fresh single-package npm project (package.json at 0.1.0; no tags, no remote, no CHANGELOG.md): the first release ships the current version as-is (v0.1.0, not 0.1.1), creates CHANGELOG.md backfilled from commit history, commits and tags v0.1.0, then asks whether and where to push without adding a remote itself.
expectations: Released version is v0.1.0 and package.json stays at 0.1.0
CHANGELOG.md is created with `## [v0.1.0] - <today>` and entries backfilled from commits
Tag v0.1.0 is created
Asks the user about pushing because no remote exists, and runs neither `git push` nor `git remote add`

evals.name: existing-tag-stops
evals.expected_output: Tag v2.0.0 already exists (with new commits after it): detects the existing target tag, stops with a one-line note, and leaves versions, commits, tags, and remotes untouched.
expectations: States that tag v2.0.0 already exists and stops
No version changes in the working tree and no new commit
No tag is created, moved, or deleted, and no `git push` runs

evals.name: no-commits-since-tag-stops
evals.expected_output: npm package at 1.0.0 whose HEAD is exactly tag v1.0.0: finds no commits since the last tag and stops with a one-line note.
expectations: States there are no commits since v1.0.0 and stops
No file changes, commits, tags, or pushes

evals.name: detached-head-stops
evals.expected_output: npm package with HEAD detached at a commit after tag v1.0.0: detects the detached HEAD and stops with a one-line note.
expectations: States that HEAD is detached and stops
No file changes, commits, tags, or pushes

evals.name: not-a-git-repo-stops
evals.expected_output: npm package directory that is not a git repository: detects it and stops with a one-line note.
expectations: States the directory is not a git repository and stops
Runs no `git init` and changes no files

evals.name: ci-release-tooling-stops
evals.expected_output: npm project with a `.changeset/` directory and new commits since v0.3.0: recognizes that Changesets owns releases and stops with a one-line note instead of bumping by hand.
expectations: Names Changesets (`.changeset/`) as the reason and stops
No version bump, CHANGELOG edit, commit, or tag

evals.name: unrelated-dirty-tree-asks
evals.expected_output: npm package (tag v1.1.0, new commits since) with an uncommitted edit to src/config.ts that no work in this session produced: stops and asks how to handle the change before releasing.
expectations: Asks the user how to handle the uncommitted src/config.ts change
No version bump, commit, tag, or push before the answer
src/config.ts is neither stashed, discarded, nor committed

evals.name: finished-work-committed-first
evals.prompt: 刚把导出 CSV 时中文乱码的问题修好了，顺便发个 patch 版本
evals.expected_output: npm package at 1.4.2 (tag v1.4.2, empty [Unreleased], origin present) with the just-finished fix uncommitted in src/export.ts: commits the fix on its own first, then releases v1.4.3 with the fix backfilled into the changelog.
expectations: src/export.ts is committed in its own commit before the release commit
The `chore(release): v1.4.3` commit contains only version and CHANGELOG changes
The `[v1.4.3]` CHANGELOG section has an entry for the CSV encoding fix

evals.name: gradle-explicit-version-changelog-links
evals.expected_output: Gradle multi-project (version=2.4.0 in gradle.properties; subproject :legacy overrides `version = "2.4.0"` in its build.gradle.kts; latest tag v2.4.0; origin present). CHANGELOG.md is written in Chinese, its [Unreleased] lists only one of the two feat commits since v2.4.0, and it ends with compare link refs. Releases exactly 3.0.0: updates both version declarations, backfills the missed feat in Chinese, and rewrites the link refs.
expectations: gradle.properties has version=3.0.0
The :legacy override in its build.gradle.kts is 3.0.0
Tag is v3.0.0, using the explicit version as-is
The `[v3.0.0]` CHANGELOG section includes the missed feat commit, written in Chinese
Link refs point `[Unreleased]` at `v3.0.0...HEAD` and add a `[v3.0.0]` compare link

evals.name: maven-revision-first-release-bump
evals.expected_output: Maven multi-module project versioned through `${revision}` (parent pom `<revision>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</revision>`; no tags; origin present): with no tag, the minor argument bumps the current 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 by editing the `<revision>` property; the tag takes the default v prefix.
expectations: Parent pom `<revision>` is 1.1.0
Child poms still reference `${revision}` rather than a hard-coded version
Tag is v1.1.0

evals.name: push-rejected-keeps-local
evals.expected_output: npm package at 2.1.0 (tag v2.1.0, new commits since) whose origin branch holds commits missing locally, so the push is rejected: stops and reports the rejection, keeping the local release commit and tag.
expectations: Reports the push rejection and stops
Local release commit and tag v2.1.1 remain in place
No force push, pull, rebase, or tag deletion is attempted

evals.name: infer-minor-from-added-asks-confirm
evals.prompt: 差不多可以发版了，帮我发一下
evals.expected_output: npm package at 1.2.0 (tag v1.2.0, new feat and fix commits since, origin present); [Unreleased] has `### Added` (CSV export) and `### Fixed` entries. No level given, so infers minor from Added, shows minor → v1.3.0 with the Added entry as evidence, and asks for confirmation before touching anything.
expectations: Infers minor and names v1.3.0 as the next version
Cites the `Added` entry as the reason for minor
Asks the user to confirm before bumping
package.json stays 1.2.0, and no release commit, tag, or push happens before the answer

evals.name: infer-minor-from-changed-only
evals.expected_output: npm package at 2.0.3 (tag v2.0.3, new commits since); [Unreleased] has only `### Changed` (refactored config loading, now reads .env.local) and `### Fixed` entries. Infers minor (Changed counts as minor), proposes v2.1.0, and asks for confirmation.
expectations: Infers minor, not patch, and proposes v2.1.0
Cites the `Changed` entry as the reason
Asks for confirmation and makes no version change, commit, or tag before the answer

evals.name: infer-patch-from-fixed-security
evals.expected_output: npm package at 1.5.2 (tag v1.5.2, new fix commits since); [Unreleased] has only `### Fixed` and `### Security` entries. Infers patch, proposes v1.5.3, and asks for confirmation.
expectations: Infers patch and proposes v1.5.3
Asks for confirmation and makes no version change, commit, or tag before the answer

evals.name: breaking-never-auto-major
evals.expected_output: npm package at 2.3.0 (tag v2.3.0, new commits including `feat!: drop Node 16`); [Unreleased] has `### Removed` (Node 16 support) marked BREAKING. Infers minor rather than major, proposes v2.4.0, notes major may fit given the breaking change and needs an explicit argument, and asks for confirmation.
expectations: Proposes minor → v2.4.0, not v3.0.0
Mentions the breaking change and that major needs an explicit choice
Asks for confirmation and makes no version change, commit, or tag before the answer

evals.name: empty-unreleased-infer-from-commits
evals.expected_output: npm package at 0.7.1 (tag v0.7.1); [Unreleased] is empty but commits since the tag are `feat(cli): add --json output` and `fix: handle empty input`. Infers minor from the feat commit, proposes v0.8.0, and asks for confirmation.
expectations: Reads commits since v0.7.1 because [Unreleased] is empty
Infers minor from the feat commit and proposes v0.8.0
Asks for confirmation and makes no version change, commit, or tag before the answer

evals.name: release-graph
evals.prompt: 模拟发 minor：干净 pnpm monorepo，root、packages/ui、packages/console 均为1.2.3，最新标签v1.2.3，origin存在；pnpm-workspace只列两个packages。仓库还跟踪 products/prototype/package.json及其lock（0.0.0，冻结设计参照），tests/fixtures/demo/package.json（1.2.3，独立fixture，不在workspace）。列出改动、保留文件、完成检查与push范围。只推演，不执行发布。
evals.expected_output: Release 1.3.0 across root/ui/console only; excluded prototype and fixture versions do not block completion; push current branch and v1.3.0 only.
expectations: release version 1.3.0
root/ui/console bumped
prototype json and lock unchanged
fixture manifest unchanged
old fixture version does not block completion
push current branch and tag only

evals.name: reference-name-release-member
evals.prompt: 模拟发 minor：pnpm workspace 明确包含 packages/prototype 和 packages/fixture，均是实际发布组件；root 与两组件当前1.2.3，最新tag v1.2.3。没有冻结路径。名称含 prototype 或 fixture 会影响升级范围吗？只推演。
evals.expected_output: Bump root and both workspace members to 1.3.0; membership, not directory names, defines release scope.
expectations: Both workspace members and root receive 1.3.0
Does not exclude a release member solely because its name is prototype or fixture
